source: winsbike-atelier (note 87 ; étrier de frein impossible régénéré, consigne finale en mains gantées), winsbike (note 91 ; établi graphite, aluminium brossé, alu anodisé ; vignette VTT refaite), efficience-triathlon (cassette impossible), talon-libre (voiture sans plaque ni logo), instinct-aventure et will-midoux (routes sans véhicule, traînées de phares).
style: Photorealistic, cinematic product-photography lighting, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, low raking side light, shallow depth of field, full-frame camera look, crisp micro-texture, clean composition with generous negative space.
interdits: No license plate, no badge, no logo on any part, no recognizable car or motorbike model, no racing number, no part assembled incorrectly, nothing floating or held loose by hand.
evite: Évite la pièce montée à l'envers ou tenue en l'air (étrier, chaîne) et la marque reconnaissable : pièces au repos sur l'établi, matières macro, routes sans véhicule ; un assemblage seulement s'il est décrit pièce par pièce.

404.consigne: A single spare part lying alone on a clean steel workbench next to its empty outline drawn in chalk, soft side light, a gentle touch of humour.
404.source: becom-d 404 (pièce à côté de son tracé)

ouverture.consigne: A wide, empty mechanic's workbench at night seen from a low three-quarter angle: a thick slab of {matieres} with fine brushed grain, faint machining marks and a thin film of oil catching the light, the centre kept empty.
ouverture.evite: La pièce maîtresse générée au centre.

section-fond.consigne: Long exposure of a winding road through a dark landscape at night, red and white light trails following the curve, starry sky, light mist, no vehicles visible.

scene-metier.consigne: Close-up of {sujet} mounted exactly as on a real working vehicle, every part bolted in its correct place, exactly two hands of one mechanic in black nitrile gloves cropped at the forearms, warm workshop light, very shallow depth of field, plain unbranded parts.
scene-metier.source: consigne finale winsbike-atelier atelier-mains (section notée 4-5 après correction)
scene-metier.evite: L'étrier au milieu du disque et la chaîne qui traverse la cassette.

lieu.consigne: Straight front view of an empty dark workshop wall with evenly spaced rows of empty hooks, soft top light with a warm rim light from one side, no tools and no parts on the hooks, clean, symmetrical.
lieu.evite: L'atelier présenté comme celui du client.

texture.consigne: Extreme macro of abstract overlapping curved bands of {matieres}, each band showing fine machining marks and crisp chamfered edges, resting on a dark surface.

portrait-generique.consigne: A rider seen from the side in silhouette at golden hour, low sun rays through the trees, face not visible, hands hidden in dark gloves, motion blur, no logo on clothing or machine.
portrait-generique.evite: Le visage et le matériel de marque.
